fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-a07aa764 at 8005f070d (attempt 2). Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'RecordAgentActor' -v: PASS for TestRecordAgentActorReusesSession, TestRecordAgentActorReusesInFlightSession (an in-flight change set's actor with the same session value is returned and no change set is written), TestRecordAgentActorLandedHandleOtherSession and TestRecordAgentActorInFlightHandleOtherSession (a landed or in-flight actor holding claude-code-0123abcd under another session value, sharing the UUIDv7 prefix, is not returned, the new actor gets another handle, and exactly one actor holds claude-code-0123abcd). The full ./internal/api package passes. Read the diff: recordAgentActor reuses an actor only when its session field equals the session ID (live, or in a non-terminal change set), and uniqueHandle now also avoids handles held in flight. The attempt-1 blocker is fixed: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-land-conflict|run-ship-change|run-ship-conflict-fix)$' passes. rhiza check, run from a clean detached worktree with this commit's build, reports no duplicate handle. Its only failures are render files for the actors of sessions live now, which is expected in a run.
